Class SurveyReportDataSetConnectorBase

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.connectors.Connector
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.connectors.ConnectorBase
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.OpenMetadataDataSetConnectorBase
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.OpenMetadataRowDataSetConnectorBase

Direct Known Subclasses:
AnnotationsTabularDataSetConnector, FileMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, FolderMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, MissingFileClassifiersTabularDataSetConnector, ProfileMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, RelationalColumnMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, RelationalDataManagerMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, RelationalSchemaMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, RelationalTableMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, RequestForActionAnnotationsTabularDataSetConnector, RequestForActionTargetsTabularDataSetConnector, ResourceMeasurementsTabularDataSetConnector, SurveyReportListTabularDataSetConnector
public abstract class SurveyReportDataSetConnectorBase extends OpenMetadataRowDataSetConnectorBase
SurveyReportDataSetConnectorBase provides the common processing for the data sets built from survey reports and their annotations.

An annotation is anchored to the surveyed asset and reused by later surveys of the same resource, so it can appear in many survey reports. Its properties are those of the most recent survey. The data sets that list what each report contained have one row for each report an annotation appears in; the measurement data sets have one row per annotation, linked to the most recent report, since the measurements in an annotation are those of that report and repeating them against earlier reports would misstate what those surveys found.
